name: fred_10yr_treasury
description:
The 10-year US Treasury constant-maturity yield from FRED, the St. Louis Fed's economic database: series DGS10 (percent, daily).
Returns {"series": "DGS10", "data": <FRED observations response>}; data.observations = [{date (YYYY-MM-DD), value (a string, "." if missing), realtime_start, realtime_end}], newest first; data is {"error": ...} if the call fails.
Inputs (* required): limit (integer, number of newest observations; default 30).
Related: fred_2yr_treasury, fred_5yr_treasury, fred_30yr_treasury, fred_yield_spread (10Y minus 2Y).
Example: {"limit": 12}

limit.description: Number of most recent observations to return (newest first)

data.description: FRED's series/observations response; {"error": ...} when the call fails

value.description: The observation's value as text ("." when FRED has none)
